title: Translation, Cross-cultural Adaptation and Validation of the MGQOL-15-F
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to translate and culturally adapt the MGQOL-15 (health-related quality of life scale for myasthenia gravis) for use with French-speaking patients in France and to evaluate its psychometric properties to ensure reliability and validity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Auto-immune myasthenia gravis
* Age ≥ 18 years old
* Clinical Classification (MGFA) I-IV
* French speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* cognitive or visual impairment which would limit the capacity to fill out the MGQOL-15-F
